exposure: CS categories: bleeding during or after CS, pre-eclampsia and eclampsia, anaesthesia-related deaths, pregnancy-related sepsis and acute collapse and embolism
cohort: Data from the 2011-2013 triennial review of the National Committee for Confidential Enquiries into Maternal Deaths in South Africa.
finding: The risk of maternal death was almost three times higher for women who had caesarean sections compared to vaginal deliveries.
